title: I’m building Chimera Arena: create your own creatures and battle with attacks you invent in real time video based on H3
author: Ill-Ant-9489
selftext:
Here’s a little teaser for **Chimera Arena**, a card game I’m building where you create your own creatures, turn them into collectible cards, and challenge other players in 2D or AI-generated video battles. The part I’m having the most fun with is inventing your own attacks: you describe what you want your creature to do, and that action can affect the fight, your opponent’s health, and the outcome. I’m curious to see what ridiculous ideas people come up with.

One of the challenges has been fitting generated video into a game people can actually play. The game resolves each exchange first, then generates a scene showing what happened. Those scenes gradually build up into a battle replay — your own little movie. There’s some waiting involved, so I’m designing the gameplay around that.

I’m also building **a small neural network for each creature**, trained on your combat decisions: the attacks you choose, how you defend, and how you use healing and support abilities. The idea is for your creature to develop a fighting style influenced by yours, then use it in autonomous 2d community battles. Two creatures with the same stats could behave differently because of how their players trained them.

There are some AR experiments too, letting you bring your creatures out of their cards and into your surroundings. Getting the really weird creatures to move properly is still a work in progress 😅 You can play directly in your browser. The game is still very much in alpha, with plenty to improve, but I’ve got way too many ideas for where to take it next.

I’d love to get people involved in creating assets, testing the game, and helping shape Chimera Arena. The first people to sign up will receive an activation code in a few weeks to generate creatures, cards, sprites, and try the game. All the creature created will become a part of the game.

Take a look at the [Chimera Arena showcase (https://chimeraarena.com/static/showcase/index.html?lang=en)](https://chimeraarena.com/static/showcase/index.html?lang=en), and [join us on Discord (https://discord.gg/T6uVu3TtMw)](https://discord.gg/T6uVu3TtMw) if you’d like to get involved!

What creature would you create, and what would its most absurd attack be?
